question: On 71d1bbfa98b0, the 10-05 reshape (mark test traffic with testing_mark, and return it to the sender) contradicts D5 and D2. Do D5–D8 still stand, or does the reshape replace them?
why_it_blocks: the 10-05 reshape (testing_mark + return-to-sender) conflicts with decisions D5 and D2 on the ticket; the build cannot pick which to follow
answered_by: Akien, recorded by caller class cc

notes.text: CC put to Akien 2026-10-13: the 10-05 reshape replaces D2 (the receiving device returns test traffic to the tester unacted on; the return is 'got here'), D5 (the mark is the testing_mark field {kind: return, test: <id>}, built by be4a7b3c7caa) and D6 (contagion: moot when receivers return unacted on); D7 (only the trouble's recipient clears it) and D8 (before/after debris census reaching 0) still stand; and on 39dbe8e8316b (open-fce0e3569004) option (b): 39db retires, the field mark replacing it.
